# azurefilesacl_avd_session_host_cleanup (Action)

Deletes stale Azure Virtual Desktop session-host artifacts before a replacement session-host VM is created.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_pool_id` (String) ARM resource ID of the Azure Virtual Desktop host pool.
- `resource_group_name` (String) Resource group name that contains the session-host VM.
- `session_host_name` (String) Session-host VM name and AVD sessionHost child-resource name.

### Optional

- `allow_current_vm_present` (Boolean) Allow cleanup to run when a same-name Azure VM exists. Use only when the action is triggered after the replacement VM is created and before it registers with AVD. Defaults to false.
- `cleanup_avd_session_host` (Boolean) Delete the AVD broker sessionHost record and associated userSessions. Defaults to false.
- `cleanup_entra_device` (Boolean) Delete matching Microsoft Entra device objects. Defaults to false.
- `cleanup_intune_managed_device` (Boolean) Delete matching Microsoft Intune managedDevice objects. Defaults to false.
- `current_vm_id` (String) Azure Compute VM instance GUID for the newly-created VM. When require_vm_absent is true, cleanup is allowed if the same-name Azure VM exists only with this VM ID.
- `force_user_sessions` (Boolean) Delete active AVD userSessions before deleting the sessionHost record. Defaults to false.
- `require_vm_absent` (Boolean) Fail without deleting artifacts when the Azure VM still exists. Defaults to true.
